# File-level evidence coverage study

Intent: improve the first page of natural-language implementation searches while preserving exact symbol queries, scopes, test intent, available files and source coordinates. This is a new candidate, not a retry of the rejected chunk-level promotion or contiguous preview study.

## Frozen candidate recipe (before implementation/retrieval)

Only when the old optional broad ranker is OFF: for an unscoped query beginning with Where/Which/How/What/Why/When, without explicit test intent or scope exclusions, compute cleaned positive concepts. Remove a fixed prose-filler list from the bonus calculation only; never change lexical candidate generation. Require3..24 concepts. Otherwise use the existing default file diversity unchanged.

Take the first24 distinct files in the retained candidate pool. For code extensions already in _SOURCE_EXTENSIONS, union the query-concept matches across all retained identity/source windows for each file. Stably put files matching at least TWO cleaned concepts before the remaining files in this first24 set. Keep the first original representative for each file, every original score, tie order and every remaining candidate object; no file reads or model calls. Preserve repeated object occurrences by original list position, not object identity. If retained text/name/path evidence exceeds1MiB, fall back to the old ordering without lexical analysis. Then apply existing file diversity. If no files or all files qualify, return the original ordering. Files outside the first24 stay outside; deep membership is preserved before token-budget rendering. This is a stable two-concept PER-FILE band, not the earlier strongest-coverage draft. Choice comes from the existing development diagnosis that chunk-local coverage missed valid files and prose words promoted unrelated hits; no new ranking data has been observed.

Fixed local prose fillers: where which what why when how can could would should will did have has had they them their that these those still then once out given instead part produced computed. Existing task_terms/query_concepts continue to define positives and exclusions. These fillers affect only the candidate promotion guard/coverage; generation and displayed match evidence remain unchanged.

## Online controls and studies

All runtime work is GHA only. First one expected baseline assertion-failure/candidate-success preflight pair with exact hashes, cases, origins and no skip/error substitutions; normal full CI only after a finished passing batch. Preserve the exact expected baseline failures as data in a successful job.

Development uses the12 explicitly CONSUMED questions in 2026-10-17-search-batch-development.json on current native-fixed baseline3bcce24. Source/file labels remain as written, no relabeling based on outputs. Three alternating baseline/candidate rounds at depth5/24 and budgets2000/8000 plus exact-file scopes. Require≥2 additional distinct judged-file/behavior observations at5, zero loss of any previously delivered judged file or excerpt at5/24/scoped, unchanged exact controls and p95≤max100ms,1.5×baseline. If rejected, preserve complete verdict and omit candidate; no variant sweep and no fresh validation consumed.

Before ANY development or validation scoring, author/freeze24 NEW validation questions over two pinned repositories: per repository8behavior+2exact+2unrelated. Use source-checked primary and supporting file anchors; disclose author/source exposure and audit against previous queries/anchors. Candidate frozen before authoring outputs. Validation gate:≥2 distinct behavior questions improve labeled evidence-file coverage at5, at least1gain/repository; zero individual labeled-file or visible-anchor losses at5/24/scoped; exact/scoped/unrelated control data unchanged; p95 threshold above. Deduplicate repeated rounds/settings when counting gains. No retune, replacement or relaunch once validation starts.

Each stage has its own existing600s/2GiB RSS+disk/64MiB evidence limit. A stage completes only with exact frozen inputs, every requested raw MCP page retained before validation, source decoding/coordinates/pinned Git bytes and loaded-engine origins admitted, request order/recomputed summaries verified before the next pack, no model runs and owned cleanup. Reject is a completed quality decision; incomplete is null.

Shared readiness barrier is specified BEFORE scoring: retain an initializing search_symbols call then public capabilities coverage polls until phase=ready, discovery not truncated, and exact parsed/reference-indexed file counts cover total_files. Do not use rounded coverage or only body-index readiness. Count all waiting inside total caps and phase timings. Do not apply this waiting retrospectively to prior incomplete experiments.
